## Why visit

A worthwhile traditional local from Liverpool CAMRA's 2026 shortlisting, with convivial back-room conversation, changing regional cask and a character distinctly removed from the city-centre show pubs. The compact room and community atmosphere are the reasons to come. Woolton is a dedicated bus/taxi outing rather than a quick addition to a central pub crawl.

## Beer

CAMRA lists three regular cask beers and one changing, including examples such as Landlord and White Rat; check the day’s board.
